intro: The Arikara Serpent Skin is the scaled hide taken from the mythical wind serpent Arikara atop Darkcloud Pinnacle. Carried back to Whitereach Post, it serves as tangible proof that the vengeance-seeking beast was summoned and slain.

p: Arikara is a formidable wind serpent tied to ancient tauren legend, rumored to seek retribution against Cairne Bloodhoof amid shifting cultural ways. Using enchanted Incendia Powder prepared under the direction of Elder Magatha Grimtotem, champions light the sacred fire atop the burial bluffs of Darkcloud Pinnacle to force the spirit-beast into the physical realm. Stripping the serpent's hide yields the Arikara Serpent Skin—an unmistakable relic of the beast's demise.
